meta_description: Dukes Towing and Recovery serving Sylva - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: A higher standard of towing in Sylva.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
coverage_h2: Sylva, and the towns around it
quote_h2: Tell us what the vehicle is doing
footer_blurb: Dukes Towing and Recovery serving Sylva.
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Sylva and the towns around it.
area_h2: We work in and around Sylva
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: Wrecker parked alongside a box truck in a lot
services.evidence: Flatbed positioned at a roadside recovery with traffic cones set out

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: Signwritten wrecker with the 24 hour towing panel on the door
services.evidence: Pickup truck loaded and secured on the flatbed with the mountains behind

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Travel trailer under tow behind the wrecker at a railroad crossing

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Flatbed with amber beacons running on a wet road at dusk

reviews.author: Shannon Falls
reviews.text: Ironically as I was driving to an automotive shop for an appointment I had an unfortunate incident on an unfamiliar road. I almost bought the farm as my car almost went off into the creek from an embankment. Thankfully it got stuck on a mound of dirt and Eric from Dukes Towing quickly came to the rescue. I called them at 7:19AM and Eric was there in less than an hour. He pulled me out of the mud and I was on my way. It wasn't the best start to my day but Eric really helped make my day better with his quick assistance and help. He turned my day around. I was so glad they were up so early to help me out of a jam. I overwhelmingly recommend their service.

reviews.author: Jessica Scott
reviews.text: Great experience! They arrived quickly, were very professional, and handled my car with care. The service was reliable and fairly priced. I’d definitely recommend them to anyone needing a tow.

reviews.author: William F. Godoy
reviews.text: Jessie and Jessie Jr are really nice guys, they saved our vacation. We were near Fontana Dam and I accidentally fell on a ditch. I called several towing companies nearby, but only Jessie was willing to drive for 1 hour, from Sylva, on Thanksgiving week. They carefully towed my car slowly for almost 2 hours to make sure no damage was done. I am very grateful for their service as we had to get back with my family through the mountains. Let them be your first choice fo the job.

reviews.author: Heath Nieddu
reviews.text: The best tow experience I've ever had after getting my truck stuck in the mud on the side of the road. My call was answered after the first ring and a truck was on site within 20 minutes. Duke's used an app that sent me messages to let me know the driver was on the way and how far out. The driver found the easiest way to get me unstuck and we were on our way. I really appreciated how easy they made it.

reviews.author: Matthew A. C. Newsome
reviews.text: They provided prompt and courteous service, even on a Saturday morning. Very friendly and considerate.

reviews.author: justin smith
reviews.text: Stellar service. My car broke down on my way to work around 7am. I called Duke’s and immediately got and answer and a dispatch. Communication was excellent with the driver sending me photos of the car prior to pickup and after delivery. Very fair pricing, as well. Will definitely call them again if I need a tow.

reviews.author: Giovanni Russo
reviews.text: These guys were amazing! My Honda Pilot slid off the pavement on a mountain road, inches away from a rollover. They worked and worked in pitch black darkness to rescue my vehicle and limit the damage. I was so grateful for their patience and expertise!

reviews.author: Allison Lynch
reviews.text: Last night I hit a deer and found myself sitting on the side of the interstate. Eric pulled over to help me out and he couldn't have been anymore awesome. Extremely kind, helpful with figuring out my next steps, and overall made the experience not as horrible. I highly recommend him for your towing needs!

reviews.author: Tracey Royal
reviews.text: Yes, Eric was wonderful. Our son got his little car stuck in the snow. Eric and I were texting back and forth about possible snow and ice on the road where our son lives. Then he thought his truck was too long. Anyway we got there and Eric got there and he winched it out no problem. Great job Eric. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Lee Caputo
reviews.text: Towing is the service you never want to need but when you do, you want someone you can trust. Had to unfortunately call a tow truck late at night for my daughter in college (we are 3.5 hours away) Eric was fast, courteous, professional and most important fair in price. Highly recommend and definitely saved their number in the unfortunate case i need these services again

reviews.author: Kristie Tolley
reviews.text: Quick response and friendly service! My family was stuck out on a side road in the middle of the night. Terry responded friendly and was at our rescue in no time. He towed us safely to the mechanic garage of my choice. The cost was cheap for the quick, friendly and safe service my family received. I also felt he was gentle with my car while loading and unloading. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lori Manzi
reviews.text: Deserves so much more than 5 Stars! I am SO thankful for Eriks kindness and help during the late and cold hours in WNC. His communication, knowledge, help and kindness meant more than he could ever know. I would recommend Duke to anyone!!

reviews.author: Duane Gabehart
reviews.text: Eric was awesome. My daughter's car broke down and we're 2 hours away. Eric let me know the price up front (which didn't change a penny), the timeline and even shared his location so I knew when he arrived. Took great care of the car, sent me pictures of the car following the tow and then made sure my daughter had a ride before leaving her at the shop. Texted to let me know all of this. As a dad taking care of his daughter from another state, I could not have been happier with Eric. Thank you.

reviews.author: Heather Woodward
reviews.text: I am so thankful for Eric and Dukes Towing and Recovery!!! After getting off late from my insane shift at Mission almost up for 20 hrs, I got a flat tire on my way home. My husband arrived an hour later after wasting time with “roadside assistance”, to find one of the lug nuts was the wrong size and we did not have the tools to get it off. We called Eric at Dukes Towing and he graciously agreed to come out. It was 11 pm when we first called and about 25 degrees outside and dark as could be. He was so professional, he sent us a gps link so we could see his arrival, he was prepared, he was quick, and he got the job done. He even followed me to the next exit as I needed air in the spare tire. He was able to take a card payment as well. Oh and as a healthcare worker, I appreciated him wearing a mask...the overall experience was just so wonderful. I read over the reviews here on Google, and they deserve every great review on here. Thank you so much Eric, I know this good karma will bless you and yours! Sincerely-Heather, Kenny, and Maddy

reviews.author: derrick harrison
reviews.text: Eric was great I was stuck in a ditch in a neighborhood trying to get to an Airbnb that we rented for the weekend and he got up at 3:30 am and took his time pulled me out and dropped my truck off at a local tire company because my tire was flat . He dropped my key off in the night drop box and took a picture of the truck and drop of the key . He is so trustworthy and reliable and went above board .

reviews.author: Darlene Lomans
reviews.text: My tire was flat. I called Duke's Towing. I am amazed at them awesome, quick and helpful service. The owner was kind, friendly easy on the eyes and a blessing to a stranded 65 year old woman. Thank you so much for your professional service. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Scott Lyon
reviews.text: Great service. We are at 4200 feet and have 14 inches of snow. When going out of my driveway for the second time that day my truck slid sideways and sunk in a soft spot in the driveway. The first company I called said they would be there in 90 minutes. Three hours later the company called and said they were not coming and why would people live up there anyway! I called Duke's and they were there in 45 minutes as promised. It was a tough job, and by then very late, but they got it done. Great people! Thanks so much for your help. I can't say enough wonderful things about this company.

reviews.author: Kit Kat
reviews.text: My friend and I went to a cabin for the New Years to have a relaxing time - until my car got stuck in the mud. Luckily with a quick google search I found this company and the guys were there sooner than I’d ever expected. I gave them the address and they were there before the cabins owner was able to drive us down the mountain. The person that answer the phone, Jesse, was extremely professional, nice, and very friendly. Jesse really helped me out when I was in a rough spot. I know that he runs a tow truck company but the level of compassion he had succeeded all forms of expectation. The other two people that came with him, Dale and Shaun, made the situation light hearted which relaxed my nerves. They all three knew exactly what they were doing, they were courteous enough to make sure my car didn’t get scratch by surround brush or get my car dirty since they had to knee down in the mud sometimes, and they made the situation less nerve wrecking by being humorous and polite. You definitely should give this company a call when you need help because they are the cheapest around, friendliest in town, and they were the most professional!!

reviews.author: Manuel Enamorado
reviews.text: Very professional people. I had to use them twice. First time was great. Had a second encounter where I needed my car towed again. I was informed that they were on their way, but I had to wait over an hour. They were misleading on their wait time. Other than that, they are good people.

reviews.author: Carson Bailey
reviews.text: My friend got her truck bottomed out on a ledge somehow..... After calling Dukes Towing and Recovery we were able to quickly assess the situation, the employees talked amongst themselves and gave a quick call back. From there a tow truck was dispatched to our location, at 2 in the morning. Fifteen minutes later the truck arrived. Options were super limited to get this truck free but the quick professionalism displayed by Anthony had the truck ready to be winched off this ledge and then driven free. We were charged a very fair price at the end of the night. Not only was Anthony able to get the truck free but interacting with him was a pleasure. If you or your friend gets stuck in the Jackson County area I would 10/10 recommend giving these gentleman a call.

reviews.author: Fern Gully
reviews.text: 5 STARS!!! Jesse and his team were able to help me out of one of the must difficult situations I have been in in a long time. I was stuck 45 minutes away from my home in a snow storm; My key was stuck in the ignition and would not start after multiple attempts by many people. I had called for just a tow cause I though my car needed to go to a show but Jesse and his team were able to get my key to turn, start my car and then they went out of my way and brought my car back to my house almost an hour away in the middle of the snow storm. They were more helpful than any tow company I have ever used in my life . I highly recommend this company over any other. Great people. Honest workers. Excellent service.

reviews.author: Jonny Temple
reviews.text: Super friendly and Helpful Company! Jesse went out of his way in a snow storm to drive to another town just to see if he could fix my girlfriends car. He was able to fix my girlfriends car and then had his tow team drive her car back to our house. He was so incredibly helpful and we will definitely use him again if we are ever in a bind or need a tow. I HIGHLY recommend Dukes Towing and Recovery. 5 star service

reviews.author: Sutton Kanipe
reviews.text: I was parked in a non-designated parking spot for an extended period of time when Dukes came to tow my car. I asked if I could move it, but it was there for too long so it either had to be paid for or towed and paid to release it. One of my friends came out and was giving the driver a hard time, but the driver remained professional and easy going while I sent my friend inside. The driver was very understanding and was helpful with different payment methods. It was my fault that the car was getting towed, but the driver worked with me and had great conversation while I was figuring out my payment. I never want to get towed, but I understand when I'm in the wrong and was happy to make the driver's job as easy as possible. Great company, will definitely call if I need any towing service in Sylva/Cullowhee. Thank you for making everything easier.

reviews.author: mario silver
reviews.text: I have had my car towed many times by very many companies. This towing company comes out on top by far. The owner is a motivated, friendly, and customer oriented individual. He is extremely professional and will do anything he can to rise up to the challenge. I had my car parked for over 18 months at a VERY difficult spot. I called multiple companies until I found Dukes. Without hesitation he said he will give it his best shot! Low and behold he made it happen! He really works with you and ensures he gives 100%. I would highly recommend Dukes over ANY towing company is the Sylva NC area.

reviews.author: Jacy Smith
reviews.text: Erik was really nice and understanding of my situation. He made the whole experience not as nerve-wracking as some other towing companies I’ve done business with! Very reasonable and affordable towing service. Thank you for your help Erik!

reviews.author: Judy Finley
reviews.text: Eric was phenomenal! I am a terminally ill patient, who cannot be in direct sunlight due to my medications, that was stranded on the side of the road with my older sister. I called Dukes Towing and my new guardian angel, Eric answered the call. He was an hour away, but showed such concern and care for our situation. He immediately found the answer for us and solved the issue over the phone. I was blown away! I have never been treated so amazingly by a stranger. I will always be grateful that he was on the other end of the phone. Thank u Eric for renewing my heart that there are still kind people in this crazy world!

reviews.author: Joseph Ekstrom
reviews.text: Erik was a great guy to work with, very personable, yet professional! Would use any of his services again! Very Customer friendly. Definitely will recommend him in the Western North Carolina area.

reviews.author: James Walawender
reviews.text: A great experience!!! It's never fun needing a tow, but Erik at Duke's, in my opinion, is probably the best around. Friendly, fair and just a good person to work with. Don't hesitate to give Duke's call when you're in a fix!

reviews.author: Susan Nevers
reviews.text: Dukes Towing came to my rescue when I got my moving truck stuck between my driveway and my neighbors driveway in a rut. Eric was there in a very short time and had me out in no time. Eric even backed my moving truck down into my driveway for me so I wouldn’t get stuck again! In addition to great customer service, a special shout out to his assistant Andrew. You guys made my day!

reviews.author: Candy Martin
reviews.text: These are the most caring, wonderful people! I accidentally drove my SUV into a very deep ditch, the bottom was on the pavement, Jessie and Jessie jr came to my rescue so quickly, got my car out and checked it over, they seriously are the best at what they do! I know God had a hand in this as they were the first wrecker service to pop up on Google search and with tears in my eyes I pressed the call button. I can't Thank Them Enough! If you need a Towing service you need to call them! Thanks Again Forever Grateful

reviews.author: Frances DeLoach
reviews.text: We can never thank you enough for coming out so quickly to get us moving again. We never knew parking on an incline would affect gas getting to the fuel line/engine. When you said, we just need to put some gas in your tank, we were so relieved it was not major, but felt like idiots. We are so grateful and now you have a funny story to tell about a dumb old couple from the coast, who have no business navigating a car in the mountains. We are forever grateful and made a friend for life in Jesse.

reviews.author: Misty James
reviews.text: These guys are amazing. Thank you so much for helping me out. It means a lot to know there is still people that care about people and are willing to help. These guys are very nice and the price is awesome. I will definitely be calling you again and highly recommend this company. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Jade Pontious
reviews.text: We lost our keys tubing, called Dukes towing to get a tow to the dealership they gave us an ETA of an hour we waited, the guy who answered in the first place said he would call on his way, never did we got worried because the dealership was closing so we waited for this guy he didn't even have the decency to let us know he canceled our tow!! So unprofessional you do not do that to customers especially tourists he literally left us stranded and would not answer our call to let us know anything! If I could leave no stars I would, never recommend him to anybody traveling out by their way.

reviews.author: Brandon White
reviews.text: Was stranded for over 3 hours outside of Asheville NC. Called many other towing companies that were closer to be told they wouldn't come out in the snow. Dukes drove over an hour to get to us and pulled us right out, and we were able to drive the rest of the way home! Driver was very friendly and professional! Wish we had called them first!!!

reviews.author: Leah Welch
reviews.text: Duke's Towing was friendly and professional. They did a great job at a reasonable price. I would recommend them and will use them again.

reviews.author: DirtyCraftinRN
reviews.text: While on vacation, we got stranded in the Smokies and Dukes Towing came to our rescue. Jesse was very friendly and showed great concern for the safety of the bike. Would recommend to anyone needing there services!!!

reviews.author: gwen shelton
reviews.text: Outstanding service!! Eric called me immediately after being contacted by my towing service to tell me exactly when he would arrive. Very polite and willing to help in any way- didn’t even mind waiting on me to pick up my granddaughter at school before meeting him at the dealership. Thanks Eric and son!!

reviews.author: Randall Truesdale
reviews.text: Duke's Towing Came to the Rescue!!! i was worried about going with a lesser known tow company...i had a breakdown with one of my cars locally @ Midnight...near the west town mall.....i made the call...and they called back within mins to inform me they could have a truck out to me in 20 mins....my tow was less than 2 miles....the driver was on time and courteous,he took care to strap my vehicle down properly.....the price was very reasonable and i will gladly call them again if needed

reviews.author: speedy1k
reviews.text: Dukes came to my rescue after another service arranged by insurance co. fell through; very professional & considerate. Kept me advised of progress which was reassuring. Would totally use these guys again.

reviews.author: Lev Habif
reviews.text: I would highly recommend using Dukes towing. They were very professional, fast, and affordable. If you are in WNC and need help, they are the ones to call. Thanks for saving my butt!

reviews.author: J. Winchester
reviews.text: Wonderful and caring people work for this company. They work fast and are super reliable and will get you where you need to go. I will recommend them to everyone. I'm glad he gave me a card so I can share. Thank y'all for your help.

reviews.author: nakayla hill
reviews.text: Duke was excellent service , not only getting my car off the side of the road at late hours but also dropping it off to an auto repair shop the next morning all for a reasonable price .

reviews.author: Jim Bentley
reviews.text: We had some issues and called Dukes. Terry came out right away and didn't charge us an arm and a leg. Very professional and fun to talk to - would definitely recommend Dukes!

reviews.author: Wanda Crawford
reviews.text: Eric was prompt, professional, and friendly. He recharged my battery quickly. I wouldn't hesitate to call again on Dukes Towing.

reviews.author: Chandler Wilkerson
reviews.text: Very helpful and nice! Offered me a good deal to get my keys out of my truck and tow it to the shop. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Annie Lanning
reviews.text: These guys did amazing very nice and got my car started in a very timely matter! Now I don’t have to stress about getting to work! Had my car started fast! That’s guys will be doing business with you guys when needed!

reviews.author: Gloria Sings
reviews.text: Had broken down on the side of 107 south bound in sylva NC, and Dukes towing was timely and easy to work with; friendly and accommodating; Will work with again in the future if need be.

reviews.author: Cynthia Norris
reviews.text: I received awesome service. They were very careful not to damage my car, took their time and came up with a solution to get it unstuck safely!

reviews.author: R. S. Cromer
reviews.text: These guys were on site quick, courteous, and the best price around. For any of my future towing needs I will definitely be using Dukes Towing and recommend them highly

reviews.author: Chloe Page
reviews.text: If you have to get your car towed you want it done by this guy. Came to my apartment in the snow and was very helpful.

reviews.author: Sarah Walker
reviews.text: Dukes is honest and promptly responded and arrived to pick up my car. They had no problem hooking up my car which was facing towards the house.

reviews.author: Ryleigh Jade
reviews.text: Dukes towing was extremely helpful. I would 100% recommend this service to anyone that needed it. 10 out of 10

reviews.author: Peggy Hipp
reviews.text: Absolutely awesome place. My son is at WCU he needed help with his vehicle they went out to university and got my son back on the road. Super nice guy put this Mom’s mind as ease.

reviews.author: Kayden Wayne
reviews.text: The right person to call when you're needing roadside help. They definitely are there to help. Support your local businesses

reviews.author: jaclyn prevette
reviews.text: He was extremely nice, punctual, and took care of me and my car. It was a great experience despite it being a trying time for my failing car.

reviews.author: Stefanie R
reviews.text: I waited all day for service from a different provider. Jesse showed up in ten minutes and was super nice and helpful. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Nathaniel Dingus
reviews.text: Had an incident on the interstate, Dukes was speedy to get there, looked out for the safety of everyone, helpful and professional. Good guys to deal with.

reviews.author: Clayton Da'Juan
reviews.text: My experience with this company was horrible. There are no words. Please, if you find yourself in need of a tow, save yourself a world of grief and call Smith's, CT's, Adam's...anybody besides these sorry junkies.

reviews.author: Gage Kornegay
reviews.text: Got stuck in the snow and thought I was gonna be there all night. He brought me and my girlfriend safely home for a great price best towing company.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Easterlin
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! Jason stopped and towed me back to my house in the middle of a snowstorm. Friendly, quick and efficient.

reviews.author: Helena Weinstein
reviews.text: Jesse was super. Did the job enthusiasticly and with great skill pulled a 20' travel trailer up to the top of the mountain.

reviews.author: Ashley Hooper
reviews.text: These people are amazing... and on this very day, my saviours. I swear I've never dealt with a kinder man in my life. Don't ever go to anyone other than them!!!

reviews.author: kimberly arch
reviews.text: Amazing people! We broke down at a gas station. They just so happen to pull up and help us. Thank you so much

reviews.author: Jennifer Tincher
reviews.text: Could not have chosen a better company!!! Fast friendly and professional!!! Thank you Eric your service was great!

reviews.author: Victoria McClure
reviews.text: Someone parked in front of my car and I was stuck at for hours because they wouldn’t answer the phone. No other tow truck would come get it because they are contracted with my complex. AWFUL

reviews.author: oh Lastoh
reviews.text: Called them at like 9 o'clock and they never showed up. Had to sit outside my own house because someone was parked in my spot

reviews.author: Tyra Lambert
reviews.text: They were so kind, helpful, came right away, worked quickly, and had me on my way! Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: CSN remodeling
reviews.text: They are excellent and fast. I recomend them . Excellent customer service . Went the extra mile to help.very friendly.

reviews.author: Mary Hambright
reviews.text: They came out in the worst weather and pulled us out of a jam on a dark, cold, snowy, wet night with a great attitude and great customer service!
